articles.title: This 245-Million-Year-Old Fossil Still Has Its Stomach Inside!
articles.summary: A nearly complete fossil from China shows the stomach, liver and intestines of a sea reptile that lived 245 million years ago. It's the oldest reptile digestive system ever found.

articles.title: One Spot in the Atlantic Ocean Is Getting Colder — And That's a Big Deal
articles.summary: A patch of ocean south of Greenland has cooled by about 1°C while the rest of the oceans warm. Scientists say a major current called AMOC is slowing down.

articles.title: This Planet Orbits Its Star Backward — And Scientists Are Stumped
articles.summary: Astronomers found an exoplanet called GJ 3090 b that orbits its star in the opposite direction. It's one of the most misaligned planets ever seen, and no one knows why.
